question: How many achievements does the game with the longest average playtime (the top point, about 1,330 minutes) have? (A) about 75 (B) about 25 (C) about 49. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the steam scatter chart. The y-axis uses a log scale for linear data. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate log scale. True answer: C (about 49). Bait: B (about 25).
